name: mahjong-solitaire
title: mahjong solitaire
blurb: an accessible mahjong pairs game: tap two matching tiles to clear them, no dragging, no timer. free tiles get a blue outline and lift up; covered or boxed-in ones sit flat and dim, so the stacking is always legible at a glance. undo and restart live in the toolbar, and a "step down a level" button is one tap away the moment a board runs out of moves. four difficulty levels, guaranteed-solvable deals, big tap targets throughout. @heartpunk.com asked for something aimed at intense accessibility for older users on older phones — this is that.
